processImprovements: [self-critique] semantic/ facts asserting a platform capability is absent (e.g. 'no delete_plugin MCP tool exists') are written with the same confidence as facts that are unlikely to change, but platform tool surfaces can shift without any corresponding code change on this brain's side being visible — this cycle's delete_plugin correction is the second time an 'absence' claim needed retroactive correction (first: create_connection owner-check, resolved via upstream fix). Absence-claims about a live third-party platform should be phrased with an explicit re-verify-if-contradicted note, not stated as settled fact.

[proposal] Add a lightweight convention for semantic-file 'absence' claims (no X exists, X is unsupported) to include the verification method and date inline so a later contradiction is recognized as new evidence rather than requiring a full reread to notice the conflict.
